Aka, the brush would just slide over my hair and not penetrate to actually brush it.  This brush actually glides through my hair without any issues. reviews.t: Child with sensory needs? Senstive scalp, this is YOUR brush!
reviews.x: Our daughter has a very sensitive scalp, doing her hair was torture. Every. Single. Day. Then I decided on giving this brush a try, I mean a softer bristle, could THAT be the secret?  YES! YES! She now lets me brush her hair with the "gentle" brush. She does not cry, doesn't run away. It smooth's the hair follicles nicely, I think it actually causes less damage to the hair. I highly recommend. Our daughter is 4, I wish I had tried this sooner!

Very happy with this product. I suffer from thin, fragile hair that falls out frequently, and I decided to switch to this to see if it might help (previously I was using a WetBrush). Far less of my hair gets pulled out by this brush. I use the comb after I wash my hair, then pat my hair with a towel and air dry. I then use the comb again, then use the brush to smooth down my hair. It's very gentle and exactly what I was looking for.

This is a very nice set and I like that it is for fine hair. It comes with a bag to put the brush in and a comb. When you brush, it feels like it’s not brushing your hair, but I know it is because I can see my hair in it haha looking forward to seeing the benefits of the boar bristles carrying the natural oils throughout my hair.
Works great. There is a smell but its minimal. Brushes well. 'Gift' box was badly damaged upon arrival so if this is a gift have a backup for wrapping.
Love to brush my hair with these brushes.
I like the comb, but haven't used the brush very often so far.  My husband's hair is too thick for the brush, and my is getting thinner everyday, so I'm a little nervous to use the brush much.

reviews.t: I have very thin fine hair and this brush still doesn't brush through all ...
reviews.x: I have very thin fine hair and this brush still doesn't brush through all of my hair. It barely brushes the top layer. I think the bristles are too soft. I would not recommend this product.
I have no clue how to tell apart real from fake boar bristles but I liked this product.

reviews.t: Overall good set - comb alone worth it!!
reviews.x: The brush is ok, takes a while to get used to and doesn’t get to my scalp well - I have a lot of fine hair, not thinning but fine.  But that comb!!!!  The wood comb is magic!  For people with lots of fine hair - it keeps it’s promise of detangling without breaking on wet or dry hair.  I would give the comb 5+ stars and the brush 4.  And for both - it’s a good value!  I did a lot of research on reviews from outside websites and this pair was rated about 8.5 out of 10.  Held true to my experience.

reviews.t: Must have one for thinning hair
reviews.x: My first experience with boar brush of any brand. This brush is really a good one to begin with. With pure BB brush, the key to using is by sectioning your hair and brushing otherwise you wont feel the brush on the scalp.I have thinning hair and an Indian woman with black hair, I ordered this recently and have been using it over the past 3 days.I can say that it straightens the hair naturally which is very wonderful to me as mine is a bit wavy. Plus without sectioning my scalp, I don't find this

reviews.t: Awful smell like plastic & bristles are too soft to penetrate fine hair
reviews.x: When it arrived, the box looked really nice and the wooden comb and brush felt nice in my hand, but the small bag that comes with it and the brush itself (I'm not sure, if its the bristles themself or the black plastic where they are attached to) stinks like hell and remindes me of cheap plastic/chemicals. I let the brush lay openly for 3 days, but the smell is still strong and when I'm trying to use it anyways, the bristles do not grip my (less then 1.5cm thick) hair at all. I'm really disappoi

Wanted something that was gentler on my thinning, weaker hair than what I was using to prevent breakage.  It's a nice brush & works well.  As many said, the bristles are not long enough to go through all of the hair, but that really wasn't my goal, as I brush on top, then underneath, I just needed something gentler overall.  The wooden comb works well on my wet hair.

reviews.t: It's a great brush but they sent me two?
reviews.x: I am unsure why but they sent me two brushes. I called amazon and let them know they told me to keep it. Honestly, I really like this brush, the wood comb did have a couple of rough spots but a little sandpaper fixed it up quickly. It made my hair soft and less frizzy. I really like this brush and comb set. Packaging was cool too. :)

reviews.t: Can't get past the smell.....which doesn't fade with wash or age
reviews.x: It smells terrible....even after you wash it.  The smell is NOT from the bristles (as the ad states), but from the rubber they use to attach the bristles to.  A complete disappointment :<
The brush is so soft that it won't penetrate even my very fine, thin hair. The bristles do not grip the hair at all.  I'm disappointed, but this product does not work for me.
I have very thin hair and this brush has a hard time going thru my strands.  Over all, I really like it though.

reviews.t: A great brush for the price!
reviews.x: I have thin hair, and my I noticed that my old brush did more damage to my hair than anything. I was looking for something a bit softer, and more gentle. This brush is great! In the past I always had issues with bristle brushes actually brushing my hair. I don't have that problem with this brush! It helps lay the fly aways down, add shine to my hair, and keep my hair healthy. The wooden comb is also great. It doesn't rip through my hair like previous combs have. I'm extremely satisfied and happy

Very disappointed with the product.  I have long hair and was looking for a brush that would easily glide through my hair with ease especially after showering.  Well the brush only brushes the very top layer of your hair and does not go through to the root!  I do NOT recommend this product unless your plans are to use it as a dog brush.  HORRIBLE

reviews.t: Doesn't brush, just slides over hair
reviews.x: Having fine hair I'm always on the lookout for gentle brushes and combs. While the brush is soft it just slides right over my hair without brushing it at all. But everyone's hair is different, so do a lot of reading before you buy. So far I like Phillips brushes the best, soft, but not too soft to not brush your hair.

reviews.t: A good choice for delicate scalp
reviews.x: I got for my Mom. She is elderly and hair thinning. The does the trick and is not harsh on her scalp. A good choice for thin hair

reviews.t: the brush and comb were fine, the shipping was slow as heck

reviews.t: DOESN'T BRUSH YOUR HAIR JUST SKIMS OVER THE TOP
reviews.x: MAYBE I CAN USE IT TO SHINE MY SHOES...  I HAVE HEARD SO MUCH ABOUT BOAR BRISTLE BRUSHES , I DONT GET THIS ONE
Very satisfied with my purchase! Works great on my straight, fine hair. Love the wooden comb, no static!
Seems well made, & hasn't lost bristles so far.  Arrived well in to the shipping window. Good purchase.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brush gentle and effective for fine, fragile, or thinning hair, with several noting less hair pulled out or breakage.
A recurring complaint is that the bristles are too soft or short to penetrate through all of the hair, especially for thicker or fuller fine hair.
Some reviewers report a strong unpleasant plastic-like smell, with a few saying it does not fade even after washing.
The wooden comb is frequently praised, with some calling it the standout part of the set and effective for detangling wet or dry hair.
Reviewers with sensitive scalps or sensory needs report that the brush is gentle enough to make hair-brushing comfortable.
